meaning: Feature-level implementation evidence, not acceptance of the 300 planned tasks. 特征级证据，不等于300题已验收。

features.limits: First-order elastic beam/column elements; explicit E/A/I/J and axes. 一阶弹性杆系。
Axial truss/brace plus elastic frames; distributed loads on axial-only members rejected. 桁架杆仅接受节点载荷。
Deterministic solver subdivision; point/start/end in metres, piecewise positions retain fractional convention. 保留物理杆件映射。
Explicit global active DOF prescribed motions; no implicit node settlement aliases. 仅显式全局活动自由度。
One selected load state per run; no implicit sum/default when multiple cases exist. 多工况逐一执行。
ON requires one explicit dead case for factors; OFF is an actual mapped setting; undeclared legacy defaults recorded. 显式绑定自重工况。
Horizontal floor with identifiable story nodes; story overrides global; 3D needs frame rotational DOFs. 楼层独立验收仍需补充。
Scalar nodal tonnes OR member-density mass, never implicit addition. 节点质量与构件密度质量互斥。
Explicit accelerations m/s2 or g; no synthetic record; no nonlinear material claim. 不以线性时程冒充非线性。
Explicit mass basis; actual eigen extraction; existing methods retain their own capability status; equivalent line wall is not shell analysis. 墙等效杆不能声称墙壳。
Requested releases, nonzero offsets, P-delta/construction stages reject. These planned tasks are not accepted. 对应规划题仍有实现缺口。
No full nonlinear computation is claimed; partial cannot satisfy formal success. 不计正式计算成功。
Preflight tests do not prove native SDK settings/readback. Irregular topology, explicit self weight/diaphragm/combination mapping need actual native evidence. 未完成native验收不得标可用。
Reviewed straight-member subdivision and IDs allowed; wrong connectivity/support/sign/position/case fails. Release/offset refinement is not yet reviewed. 不按视觉相似判对。
Signed endpoints and exact case/combination; commercial envelope station/reversal transform unverified and rejected. 不用绝对值掩盖反号。
Opt-in for new tasks: current model hash, immutable run ID, executed solver/version, pending/partial rejection. Raw artifact audit remains part of corpus acceptance. 新题启用，旧fixture不重写。
